newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end at highs, eyes on auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end at highs, eyes on auction.

text.p: 1700 GMT - Portuguese bonds closed at highs amid strong buying of 3- and 5-year bonds. Focus on 3-yr auction tomorrow.
*Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash +1 bps vs +1 bps cls
Portuguese bonds closed at highs in sympathy with foreign markets amid strong buying of three- and five-year maturities.
Dealers said they expected spreads against 10-year Bonos to remain flat tomorrow. They said the spread of 10-year Portuguese bonds over Bunds was expected to remain around 95 basis points.
"The market closed at the highs in line with Spain," said one operator. "There should be plenty of demand at tomorrow's three-year T-bond auction."
